# Do you have to report under the CSRD?

> Free EU CSRD scope checker: are you in mandatory sustainability reporting under the original CSRD and under the Omnibus thresholds (1,000 employees and EUR 450M turnover), from which financial year, and what to do if you are only squeezed by customer data requests. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
